name: Clipboard Manager for Elementor
author: Coddium

sections.description:
Clipboard Manager for Elementor enhances Elementor’s built-in clipboard with a multi-item stack. Every time you copy a widget or container, it’s added to your clipboard history. Select any item (or multiple items) and paste them with Ctrl+V / ⌘V — just like Elementor’s native clipboard, but better.

Features

  • Multi-item clipboard stack — automatically captures every Ctrl+C / ⌘C
  • Native clipboard compatibility — Ctrl+V / ⌘V pastes the selected item(s), no workflow changes
  • Floating panel — draggable, resizable dialog; can be stacked below Elementor’s Structure panel
  • Multi-select paste — Ctrl+Click / ⌘+Click to toggle, Shift+Click to select a range, paste them all at once via Ctrl+V / ⌘V or the header paste button
  • Rename items — double-click to rename for easy identification
  • Persistent storage — items survive page reloads (localStorage)
  • Item type icons — visual indicators of element types
  • Cut support — Ctrl+X / ⌘X cuts selected elements to the clipboard manager
  • Context menu integration — “Cut” in right-click menu
  • Delete key — press Del or Backspace to delete selected items from the keyboard
  • Keyboard shortcut — Ctrl+Shift+C / ⌘⇧C to toggle the clipboard panel
  • Top bar button — quick access from Elementor’s top bar
  • Export/Import — save and share clipboard collections as JSON; move your clipboard between sites

Pro Features

  • Favorites — star any item to keep it when clearing all and find it quickly in the Favorites tab
  • Search/Filter — filter clipboard items by name or element type
  • Drag to reorder — grab any item and drop it to rearrange your clipboard stack
  • Container tree — expand containers to view, paste, or delete individual child elements
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/clipboard-manager-for-elementor/ or install through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open any page in the Elementor editor — the clipboard panel is available from the top bar.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • Elementor 3.23.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
sections.faq:
Does this break Elementor’s native copy/paste?

No. The plugin enhances native behavior without modifying it. Every Ctrl+C / ⌘C and Ctrl+V / ⌘V works exactly as before. We simply capture copies and allow you to select which item to paste.

How do I paste a specific item?

Click the item in the clipboard panel to select it, then use Ctrl+V / ⌘V as usual. The selected item will be pasted instead of the most recent copy.

Can I paste multiple items at once?

Yes. Ctrl+Click / ⌘+Click to toggle individual items or Shift+Click to select a range, then Ctrl+V / ⌘V to paste all selected items at once.

Where are clipboard items stored?

In your browser’s localStorage. Items persist across page reloads but are specific to your browser.

Can I save my clipboard items to a file for later use or as a backup?

Yes. Click the Export button (↑) in the clipboard panel header to copy all items as a JSON string to your system clipboard. Paste that text into a .txt or .json file and save it anywhere you like.

To restore, click the Import button (↓), then paste the JSON text when prompted. Your clipboard items will be replaced with the imported set.

This is useful for backing up your clipboard collection, sharing component sets with teammates, or moving items between projects.

Can I keep important items when clearing the clipboard?

Yes — with the Pro version, mark items as favorites by clicking the star icon. Favorited items are preserved when Clear All is used.
